findings.issue: SHAPE extent plan had no zero-size extent
findings.resolution: A(3:2,2:4) gives [0,3], B(-1:1,2:5) gives [3,4], and a scalar SOURCE gives a zero-size result, each with a non-vacuous companion

findings.issue: SHIFTA/SHIFTL/SHIFTR omitted the SHIFT = BIT_SIZE(I) edge
findings.resolution: bit-context POPCNT/BTEST plans: SHIFTL/SHIFTR shift every bit out, SHIFTA fills with the leftmost bit (set and clear cases), and SHIFT = 0 leaves I unchanged bitwise
